SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.user_resident_no AS userResidentNo, u.user_name AS userName, u.user_email AS userEmail, u.user_tel AS userTel, u.user_phone AS userPhone, u.user_position_cd AS userPositionCd, u.inst_id AS instId, p.code_name AS userPositionName, u.create_dt AS createDt, u.update_dt AS updateDt, u.del_yn AS delYn FROM t1000_user u LEFT JOIN total_code p ON u.user_position_cd = p.code_id
AND u.del_yn = #{delYn}
AND u.inst_id = #{instId}
AND u.user_name LIKE '%' || #{userName} || '%'
AND u.user_email LIKE '%' || #{userEmail} || '%'
AND u.user_phone LIKE '%' || #{userPhone} || '%'
AND p.code_name LIKE '%' || #{userPositionName} || '%'
AND u.create_dt >= #{createDt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND u.create_dt < (#{updateDt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} + 1)
AND u.update_dt >= #{createDt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND u.update_dt < (#{updateDt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} + 1)
ORDER BY u.create_dt DESC, u.user_no DESC
ORDER BY u.update_dt DESC, u.user_no DESC
ORDER BY u.user_no DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
